name: zzbd_section_handler_list_constructor
description: zZbdSectionHandlerList::Constructor allocates and initializes an empty self-referencing section-handler list sentinel.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD STL-list helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c0b70 validates allocation of a 28-byte sentinel, self-referencing next/prev initialization, sentinel storage at offset 4, and count reset at offset 8.
The native smoke constructs a list and verifies the allocated sentinel points to itself in both directions with count zero.
